authority_row_verbatim.jurisdiction: Separately admits respondent universes for forward discovery, reverse possibility inference, and structural empirical admission
authority_row_verbatim.why_required: D12G establishes that source relevance/admissibility can differ by terminal service and locality alone does not choose a source
authority_row_verbatim.downstream_outputs: admitted source-indexed universe list or typed nonapplicability/noncomparability
authority_row_verbatim.prohibited_inferences: May not silently backfill broader sources;may not average admitted universes;may not imply respondent linkage or pooling

recovered_function.what_it_did: DERIVED which respondent universes are ADMISSIBLE for a specific service and target use, from the joint input of (EmpiricalUniverse identity, service, target use, time/geography/population scope).
recovered_function.what_it_was_not: It was not a validator of a caller-supplied set. The service parameter is a REQUIRED upstream input, so the authority cannot be exercised unless a service and a target use are supplied.
recovered_function.output_shape: an admitted source-indexed universe list, OR a typed nonapplicability / noncomparability
recovered_function.authority_grain: PER SERVICE, and INDEPENDENTLY per source/universe

d12g_corroboration.service_specificity_verbatim: each source/universe requires independent service-specific applicability authority
d12g_corroboration.locality_rule_verbatim: locality or country identity alone does not assign a priority weight
d12g_corroboration.terminal_service_verbatim: What later meaning/use that fact has depends on the separately governed terminal service: forward discovery, reverse positioned-subject possibility inference, structural-field production, or no promoted use.
d12g_corroboration.significance: Two independent historical artifacts agree. D15 is the ledger entry; D12G is the adjudication that established the rule it implements.

obsolete_topology: a single per-service registry/resolver as a distinct component
topology_not_inherited.note: The FUNCTION is recovered; the component shape is not assumed. This audit determines whether any current component performs the function, not whether a component with the same name exists.
